title: Birman-Schwinger compact kernel of the free resolvent as bound-state master
expression_sketch: Self-adjoint: H = -Delta - V on R^n, V: R^n -> [0, oo). For lambda < 0, K_lambda = sqrt(V) * (-Delta - lambda)**(-1) * sqrt(V). Equivalence: lambda < 0 is an eigenvalue of H iff 1 is an eigenvalue of K_lambda of the same multiplicity; N_lambda := # {eigenvalues of H <= lambda} equals # {eigenvalues of K_lambda >= 1}. Integral kernel: K_lambda(x, y) = sqrt(V(x)) * G_lambda(x - y) * sqrt(V(y)), G_lambda = kernel of (-Delta - lambda)**(-1). Dimension n = 3: K_lambda(x, y) = sqrt(V(x)) * exp(-sqrt(-lambda)*|x-y|) / (4*pi*|x-y|) * sqrt(V(y)). Alternate factorisation: K_lambda = (-Delta - lambda)**(-1/2) * V * (-Delta - lambda)**(-1/2). Non-self-adjoint: for lambda in C \ [0, oo), K_lambda = sgn(V)*sqrt(|V|) * (-Delta - lambda)**(-1) * sqrt(|V|); lambda is an eigenvalue of -Delta - V iff 1 is an eigenvalue of K_lambda.
latent_structure: A one-parameter family of compact integral operators K_lambda, built from the free resolvent at spectral parameter lambda, is the master object. Bound states of the unbounded Schrödinger operator are members of that family selected by the eigenvalue-1 condition. The 3D kernel is the decaying Yukawa specialisation of the free Green function, not a CSE of two copies of sqrt(V). Compactness/Schatten norms of K_lambda reconstruct the counting function N_lambda.

lambda.notes: spectral parameter; self-adjoint principle is written for lambda < 0

n.notes: space dimension; explicit kernel is written for n = 3

V.notes: self-adjoint statement: V : R^n -> [0, oo); regularity so that K_lambda is bounded and compact

function_domains.K_lambda: Birman-Schwinger operator; bounded and compact under the source regularity assumptions on V
function_domains.G_lambda: integral kernel of the free resolvent (-Delta - lambda)**(-1)

nonzero_conditions.statement: The classical 3D kernel is written with |x-y| in the denominator (x != y)
nonzero_conditions.label: DECLARED
nonzero_conditions.source: Wikipedia Birman-Schwinger principle, The Birman-Schwinger bound: K_lambda(x,y) = sqrt(V(x)) * exp(-sqrt(-lambda)|x-y|)/(4*pi*|x-y|) * sqrt(V(y))

positivity_conditions.statement: In the self-adjoint Schrödinger statement, V maps R^n into [0, oo)
positivity_conditions.label: DECLARED
positivity_conditions.source: Wikipedia Birman-Schwinger principle, Statement of the principle: 'real-valued potentials V : R^n -> [0, oo)'

positivity_conditions.statement: The self-adjoint eigenvalue equivalence is written for negative spectral parameter lambda < 0
positivity_conditions.label: DECLARED
positivity_conditions.source: Wikipedia Birman-Schwinger principle: 'establishing that lambda < 0 is an eigenvalue of the Schrödinger operator if and only if 1 is an eigenvalue of K_lambda of the same multiplicity'

analytic_domains.statement: For the self-adjoint principle, lambda < 0 (below the free continuum [0, oo))
analytic_domains.label: DECLARED
analytic_domains.source: Wikipedia Birman-Schwinger principle, Statement of the principle for self-adjoint Schrödinger operators

branch_conventions: For lambda < 0 the 3D formula uses the positive square root sqrt(-lambda) so that exp(-sqrt(-lambda)|x-y|) decays.
Wikipedia writes H = -Delta - V (attractive sign in the potential term).

derived_conditions.statement: On the 3D kernel, Hilbert-Schmidt control of K_lambda yields the Birman-Schwinger bound on N_0
derived_conditions.label: DERIVED
derived_conditions.source: Wikipedia Birman-Schwinger principle, The Birman-Schwinger bound: N_0 <= (4*pi)**(-2) * double integral V(x)V(y)/|x-y| dx dy

public_source: Wikipedia, Birman-Schwinger principle (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Birman%E2%80%93Schwinger_principle); Birman, Mat. Sb. 55 (1961); Schwinger, PNAS 47, 122 (1961), doi:10.1073/pnas.47.1.122.
why_not_cse_lgg: CSE can share sqrt(V(x))sqrt(V(y)) but does not identify the compact kernel as the free-resolvent master whose eigenvalue-1 locus is the bound-state set. First-order LGG antiunifies two Green evaluations without the spectral-parameter family or the Schatten counting reconstruction N_lambda.
proposer_leak_risk: Do not plant 'Birman-Schwinger', 'Lieb-Thirring', or 'Cwikel-Lieb-Rozenblum' as gold target wording. Keep the decaying 3D kernel distinct from the outgoing Helmholtz Green (historical ac-r03).
notes: Not Lindhard, not Lippmann-Schwinger, not Kato simple eigenvalue, not Guo. The 3D kernel resembles a Yukawa Green of (-Delta - lambda) at lambda < 0; it is not the radiating Helmholtz member e^{i k R}/(4*pi*R) of ac-r03. No i epsilon is used: the written domain is lambda < 0 or lambda in C \ [0, oo). Not admitted here.
